authorization: The user explicitly authorized execution of the reviewed subtractive single-P program and removed the proposed no-clipping and support-microstep-reduction levels from scope.
scientific_question: How far can the clean no-time single-P recurrent learner be simplified in architecture and optimization while retaining generic relational competence, causal dependence on P, and globally coherent query structure without human-target fitting?
claim_boundary: This is a fixed three-seed development ladder. It identifies a simplification boundary along one prospectively ordered deletion path, not a globally minimal architecture or a population success rate.

The ladder is C0, M1, M2, M3, M5_H100, and M5_H50. Runtime P clipping at [-50,50], four support microsteps, and two query microsteps remain fixed by explicit user decision; no no-clipping M4 or microstep-reduction M6 result is estimated.

Only clean fixed-four-block generic relational training is used. No noisy-training arm, variable-horizon curriculum, prefix loss, human target, Liu summary, relation-type label, intervention label, or evaluation outcome enters optimization.

All 28 query labels supervise generic episodic relational competence. Competence is therefore learned under supervision; only organization not explicitly represented in the objective may be described as emergent under the registered task and observation prior.
The upstream p/z stable-omission scaffold generates realized q but neither p nor z enters the model. Any individualized behavior later observed is conditional on this structured observation process.
Human/Liu evaluation is prohibited in this development study. A separately frozen fresh cohort is required to estimate the selected recipe's solution distribution or human-facing phenotype.
No seed replacement, checkpoint selection, learning-rate scan, budget extension, result-dependent initialization, compensatory auxiliary loss, or continuation after a registered stop is permitted.

design.pairing: Within a network seed, every executed level receives the same generic episodes, presentation order, stable omission, realized clean q, and update chronology. C0 and M1 begin from bit-identical parameters. At H=200, later levels preserve the same direct draws for every shared tensor; M2 and later intentionally zero-initialize the scalar modulation head.
design.exposure_barrier: For an executed level, train and artifact-lock all three final checkpoints before computing registered generic outcomes. A level outcome is then frozen before the stop rule is applied to any successor. Training diagnostics are integrity records and cannot alter the recipe.

input_channels.31: one realized signed observation q; zero on queries

common.state_policy: P persists across support trials and resets between episodes; h and E reset per trial; every query reads the same terminal P with fresh h/E and no P writeback.
common.equations: h'=tanh(W_x x+b+(W_rec+A(P))h); m=u^T h+c; P'=clip(P+mE,-50,50); E'=(1-eta_E)E+eta_E*tanh(h'h_old^T). Preserve P-before-E update order.

C0.alpha: learned dense 200x200 alpha with initialization Uniform[-0.01,0.01]
C0.scientific_change: canonical direct 32-channel initialization and single-rate optimization replace the legacy shadow-coordinate training geometry; architecture and terminal-P penalty otherwise remain inherited

M2.alpha: absent; A(P)=P so P is the effective recurrent increment
M2.modulation_initialization: exactly zero weights and bias so the write scale is learned without a fixed alpha replacement scale

M3.eta_E: fixed exactly at 1 and absent from parameters and buffers
M3.scientific_change: remove learned eligibility timescale while preserving the historical one-step P-before-E chronology

M5_H100.scientific_change: halve hidden width and reduce P from 40000 to 10000 episode-state scalars

M5_H50.scientific_change: halve hidden width again and reduce P to 2500 episode-state scalars

initialization.direct_only: Instantiate the maintained 32-channel candidate directly. No legacy shadow network, checkpoint, mapped duplicate coordinate, or transformed optimizer state is constructed.
initialization.input_and_heads: Use PyTorch Linear.reset_parameters fan-in initialization for cue projection and the two affine heads, except that M2 and later set modulation weight and bias exactly to zero after the common draw.
initialization.pairing: Construct the same full canonical parameter order under one torch seed before deleting alpha or eta_E, so removal cannot change shared H=200 initialization draws.

training.task: Generic N=8 graph-bucket-one connected ranking episodes with 7--10 support edges, four presentation blocks, stable omission, protected Liu graph signatures excluded, and all 28 unordered query pairs equally weighted.
training.observation: Use one clean realized q from the inherited p/z scaffold; no added observation noise.
training.optimizer: One Adam parameter group for every trainable tensor; betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=false; no scheduler and no gradient clipping.

loss.C0: mean softplus(-y*M) over all generic queries plus 1e-4*mean(P_T^2)
loss.M1_and_later: mean softplus(-y*M) over all generic queries

training.selection: Final update only; no early stopping, intermediate checkpoint selection, restart selection, result-conditioned continuation, or optimizer change.
training.diagnostic_boundary: Diagnostics establish integrity and describe dynamics; they are not tuning signals or scientific gates.

qualification.fixtures: Use synthetic non-Liu seeds outside 3031--3033 and outside evaluation panels. Qualification may not load prior or prospective scientific checkpoints.
qualification.algebra: For every level, an independent eager reference must match margin, modulation, h, E, P, loss, gradients, and one Adam update within atol=1e-6 and rtol=1e-5.
qualification.structure: Assert exact public input width, hidden width, parameter count, alpha/eta presence, modulation initialization, P clipping, P-before-E order, four support steps, two query steps, and absence of every forbidden path.
qualification.initialization: Assert deterministic direct regeneration, bit-identical C0/M1 initialization, identical shared H=200 tensors where specified, no shadow construction, and zero modulation only for M2 and later.
qualification.stream: Assert byte-identical task and q streams across levels for each network seed and sensitivity to seed/update changes.
qualification.evaluation: Synthetic fixtures must verify canonical pair orientation, exact P_off construction, learned/nonlearned grouping, Hodge coherence, percentile intervals, level outcome precedence, and stop transitions.
qualification.cuda: Eager and compiled CUDA outputs, P, loss, gradients, and one Adam update must match within atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-4.
qualification.failure: Any failed qualification blocks scientific training. An implementation-only repair must be append-only and may not alter seeds, equations, levels, thresholds, or stop rules.

evaluation.inputs: Three frozen panels per network seed; each panel contains 256 fresh graph-bucket-zero generic episodes under the same clean four-block task, grouped only by support length for execution.
evaluation.statistics: Use 2000 percentile-bootstrap draws and 95% intervals within each panel. Episodes are the resampling unit; networks are never pooled as participants.

endpoints.competence: Intact exact correct probability for learned and nonlearned pairs.
endpoints.P_dependence: Paired intact-minus-P_off exact correct probability for learned and nonlearned pairs.
endpoints.coherence: Gradient-energy fraction of the intact canonical complete-graph margin field.

evaluation.human_blind: Do not construct, load, or evaluate Liu/human inputs, human intervals, noisy-training compensation, or historical nine-row flags in this study.

decision.integrity: Every executed level has exactly three finite final models, 1500 optimizer steps for every trainable parameter, complete paired training streams, correct identities and parameter counts, and a committed artifact lock before evaluation.
decision.per_seed_core: A network passes only if every panel has intact learned and nonlearned probability lower95>0.5, intact-minus-P_off learned and nonlearned probability lower95>0, and coherence lower95>0.95.

level_outcomes.clear_continue: All three seeds pass the per-seed core.
level_outcomes.mixed_boundary: One or two of three seeds pass. Stop deletion without recipe repair; characterize this instability in a separately frozen larger cohort if pursued.
level_outcomes.structural_collapse: Zero of three seeds pass. Stop and retain the latest predecessor with clear_continue; if C0 collapses, close the simple-training route as failed.

progression.M5_H50: Terminal ladder level; report its outcome and stop.

decision.selection_boundary: The selected recipe is the last clear_continue level before a structural_collapse. A mixed_boundary is not silently promoted or repaired; it identifies the level requiring the separately registered 20-network solution-distribution cohort.
decision.forbidden_rescue: Human phenotype, later-level success, training diagnostics, a hand-picked seed, or an unregistered rerun cannot rescue a failed or mixed level.

execution.runtime: CUDA float32 without autocast or TF32; compiled fullgraph/default training; one Torch/BLAS/compiler thread; float64 summaries.
freeze_points: Commit this protocol and study registration before implementation or scientific outcome exposure.
Commit qualified implementation and source/input lock before training C0 seed3031.
For each authorized level, train all three models and commit their joint artifact lock before evaluation.
Freeze and commit that level's result before applying the registered stop rule or beginning its successor.
After the ladder stops, register any 20-network solution-distribution cohort separately before training it.
outputs: one joint artifact lock for each executed level
one canonical result and concise report for each executed level
execution.retention: Keep protocols, locks, canonical level results, reports, and final checkpoints until a separately authorized retention migration. Preserve the frozen anytime tradeoff and all negative ladder levels.
